request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only his clothes: remove the red tabard so his bare pale warm ivory ribcage, spine and hip bones show; he wears only a short ragged near-black charcoal loincloth with a thin bright violet trim; the red helmet crest becomes a ragged near-black crest; his eye sockets glow bright violet and the small blue flame becomes bright violet. Keep the skull, helmet, sword, shield, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
